description: This file implements a React component for displaying detailed information about a defect, including its description, root cause, image, and associated corrective actions. It handles data fetching from an API, user interactions like adding/deleting actions, toggling their status, and navigation.

methods.name: asId
methods.description: Converts a string or string array parameter into a numeric ID.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches defect details and associated actions from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current defect after user confirmation and navigates back to the defects list.

methods.name: onCreateAction
methods.description: Creates a new corrective action associated with the defect after form submission.

methods.name: toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a corrective action.
